integrity: The complete standalone Python 3 verifier reproduces the 56-count through distinct explicit factor listings and independent inclusion-exclusion, and checks all finite cases claimed. Source characterization of irreducibility is used and credited.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive finite classification for the ordinary numerical semigroup of multiplicity 28 only; no general all-multiplicity assertion. The motivating paper had already identified the first exception and exhibited a four-factor example. Historical priority of the 56-count is provisional; no independent expert audit.
title: All 56 shortest irreducible decompositions of the first exceptional ordinary numerical semigroup
